rule: Each restricted RL-edit cell's count of right answers on hard328 with the cue is read off the stored dial curve of the unrestricted top-8 edit (right of 328 at edit scales 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2: 164, 170, 192, 203, 190; seed 3000000, T 1.0) at an effective scale. The effective scale is the share of the 1.5x edit that the restricted edit keeps along that edit: a norm-matched projection keeping squared-norm share k leaves 1.5 x sqrt(k) of it, using the stored kept shares from xchannel run-02 (result-ce52f8: m=64 readers/writers 0.757/0.780, m=8 0.398/0.416). Two sets of stored cells calibrate this. First, norm-matched edits that keep about none of the edit's component (inputs or outputs randomized, pairs shifted, random; 158, 163, 160, 159) score like base, so the full-norm view fails and the along-edit scale is the covariate. Second, partial edits (layer bands at 1.5x 184/183/166, top-1 per matrix at 1x/2x 181/184, attention-only 178, MLP-only 181) land between the along-edit interpolation and the kept-norm interpolation, and none below 8 directions in all layers reached 190 (result-306787). So a small kept share (m=8) gets a small downward pull toward that 178-184 plateau, and a large kept share (m=64) stays near the interpolation, close to the stored k=64 edit (200). Intervals combine one-sample noise for a single cell (paired 90 % half-width about 14 counts, result-6f1bb7) with the spread between the two interpolation views.
